items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: Peery lived directly behind me on 129th Street and he had heard me practicing on my house and he said, 'Hey, clarinet player,' I didn't know him, he didn't know me.

ctx.x: Peery Bradford -- he was the guy that did it.
What did records sell for in those days out of the stores?
